22item%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fopenart.ai%2F%22%7D%5D%7D%2C%7B%22%40context%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fschema.org%22%2C%22%40type%22%3A%22FAQPage%22%2C%22mainEntity%22%3A%5B%7B%22%40type%22%3A%22Question%22%2C%22name%22%3A%22What%20is%20OpenArt%20AI%3F%22%2C%22acceptedAnswer%22%3A%7B%22%40type%22%3A%22Answer%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22OpenArt%20is%20an%20all-in-one%20platform%20for%20creating%20AI%20images%20and%20videos.%20Whether%20you%20want%20a%20product%20ad%2C%20a%20TikTok%20reel%2C%20a%20short%20film%2C%20or%20a%20virtual%20character%20that%20posts%20content%20for%20you%2C%20you%20can%20make%20it%20all%20on%20OpenArt%2C%20without%20specialized%20editing%20software%2C%20design%20background%2C%20or%20technical%20skills.%22%7D%7D%2C%7B%22%40type%22%3A%22Question%22%2C%22name%22%3A%22Is%20OpenArt%20free%3F%22%2C%22acceptedAnswer%22%3A%7B%22%40type%22%3A%22Answer%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22Yes.%20You%20can%20start%20creating%20on%20OpenArt%20for%20free%20with%20a%20trial%20plan%2C%20with%20daily%20credits%20and%20no%20credit%20card%20required.%20Paid%20plans%20unlock%20the%20most%20powerful%20AI%20models%2C%20longer%20video%20generation%2C%20and%20higher%20quality%20exports.%22%7D%7D%2C%7B%22%40type%22%3A%22Question%22%2C%22name%22%3A%22Can%20I%20use%20what%20I%20create%20on%20OpenArt%20for%20my%20business%20or%20brand%3F%22%2C%22acceptedAnswer%22%3A%7B%22%40type%22%3A%22Answer%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22Yes.%20You%20fully%20own%20what%20you%20create%20and%20can%20use%20it%20however%20you%20like%2C%20in%20ads%2C%20on%20social%20media%2C%20in%20client%20work%2C%20on%20merchandise%2C%20or%20anywhere%20else.%20No%20royalties%2C%20no%20attribution%20required.%22%7D%7D%2C%7B%22%40type%22%3A%22Question%22%2C%22name%22%3A%22Which%20AI%20models%20does%20OpenArt%20use%3F%22%2C%22acceptedAnswer%22%3A%7B%22%40type%22%3A%22Answer%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22OpenArt%20brings%20together%20the%20best%20AI%20models%20in%20one%20place%2C%20including%20Seedream%205.0%2C%20Seedance%202.0%2C%20Google%20Veo%203%2C%20GPT%20Image%202%2C%20Nano%20Banana%20Pro%2C%20Sora%202%2C%20Kling%203.0%2C%20Grok%20Imagine%2C%20MiniMax%20Hailuo%2C%20and%20HappyHorse.%20Instead%20of%20paying%20for%20several%20separate%20tools%2C%20you%20get%20them%20all%20under%20one%20subscription%20and%20can%20pick%20whichever%20one%20fits%20the%20content%20you're%20making.%22%7D%7D%2C%7B%22%40type%22%3A%22Question%22%2C%22name%22%3A%22Can%20I%20create%20the%20same%20character%20across%20different%20scenes%20and%20videos%3F%22%2C%22acceptedAnswer%22%3A%7B%22%40type%22%3A%22Answer%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22Yes!%20This%20is%20one%20of%20OpenArt's%20most-loved%20features.%20Create%20a%20character%20once%2C%20and%20you%20can%20place%20them%20in%20any%20outfit%2C%20scene%2C%20or%20video%20with%20the%20same%20face%20and%20look%20every%20time.%20It's%20how%20creators%20build%20AI%20influencers%2C%20recurring%20brand%20mascots%2C%20and%20full%20stories%20with%20consistent%20characters.%22%7D%7D%2C%7B%22%40type%22%3A%22Question%22%2C%22name%22%3A%22Can%20OpenArt%20make%20videos%20with%20talking%2C%20music%2C%20and%20sound%3F%22%2C%22acceptedAnswer%22%3A%7B%22%40type%22%3A%22Answer%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22Yes.%20You%20can%20make%20videos%20where%20characters%20speak%20with%20synced%20lip%20movements%2C%20add%20original%20AI-generated%20music%2C%20and%20include%20realistic%20sound%20effects%2C%20all%20inside%20OpenArt.%20Great%20for%20everything%20from%20quick%20social%20clips%20to%20full%20cinematic%20videos.%22%7D%7D%2C%7B%22%40type%22%3A%22Question%22%2C%22name%22%3A%22Will%20my%20videos%20fit%20TikTok%2C%20Reels%2C%20and%20YouTube%3F%22%2C%22acceptedAnswer%22%3A%7B%22%40type%22%3A%22Answer%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22Yes.%20OpenArt%20exports%20in%20every%20format%20and%20aspect%20ratio%20you%20need%3A%20vertical%20for%20TikTok%2C%20Reels%2C%20and%20Shorts%3B%20widescreen%20for%20YouTube%20and%20ads%3B%20square%20for%20Instagram%20feeds%3B%20and%20cinematic%20ratios%20for%20film.%20Just%20pick%20the%20platform%20and%20your%20video%20comes%20out%20ready%20to%20post.%22%7D%7D%2C%7B%22%40type%22%3A%22Question%22%2C%22name%22%3A%22How%20is%20OpenArt%20different%20from%20tools%20like%20Midjourney%2C%20Runway%2C%20or%20Sora%3F%22%2C%22acceptedAnswer%22%3A%7B%22%40type%22%3A%22Answer%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22Most%20AI%20tools%20specialize%20in%20one%20thing.%20Midjourney%20is%20mainly%20for%20images%2C%20Sora%20and%20Runway%20are%20built%20for%20video.%20But%20OpenArt%20brings%20images%2C%20videos%2C%20characters%2C%20music%2C%20and%20editing%20into%20one%20place%2C%20with%20every%20leading%20AI%20model%20built%20in.%20You%20don't%20need%20five%20different%20subscriptions%20or%20constantly%20move%20files%20between%20separate%20apps.%22%7D%7D%2C%7B%22%40type%22%3A%22Question%22%2C%22name%22%3A%22Do%20I%20need%20to%20know%20how%20to%20use%20AI%20or%20edit%20videos%20to%20get%20good%20results%3F%22%2C%22acceptedAnswer%22%3A%7B%22%40type%22%3A%22Answer%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22Not%20at%20all.%20OpenArt%20is%20built%20for%20everyday%20creators.%20You%20describe%20what%20you%20want%20in%20plain%20words%2C%20pick%20a%20style%2C%20and%20the%20platform%20handles%20the%20rest.%20If%20you%20want%20more%20control%2C%20advanced%20tools%20are%20there%20when%20you're%20ready%20and%20you%20can%20always%20refine%20your%20prompts%2C%20but%20you%20can%20still%20make%20great%20content%20from%20your%20very%20first%20try.%22%7D%7D%2C%7B%22%40type%22%3A%22Question%22%2C%22name%22%3A%22Is%20my%20work%20private%20and%20safe%20on%20OpenArt%3F%22%2C%22acceptedAnswer%22%3A%7B%22%40type%22%3A%22Answer%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22Yes.%20Your%20creations%20stay%20private%2C%20payments%20are%20handled%20securely%2C%20and%20OpenArt%20has%20safeguards%20in%20place%20to%20keep%20the%20platform%20safe%20and%20responsible%2C%20so%20you%20can%20create%20with%20confidence%20whether%20you're%20creating%20for%20personal%20or%20professional%20use.%22%7D%7D%5D%7D%5D%7D
